ZOMBIE_LOSTCITY_RELICHUNTER_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}760
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.155
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}swings past defenses randomly in the 4th, 5th or 6th column

{FLAVOR}Relic Hunter has hunted some pretty impressive relics in his day. Idols, antiques, curios... he’s hunted 'em all.
ZOMBIE_LOST_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION: {FLAVOR}Given the rarity of traffic in the jungle, it’s a mystery how Conehead Adventurer managed to acquire his headgear. Maybe he ordered it online?
ZOMBIE_LOST_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: His makeshift cone gives him twice the toughness of a normal explorer zombie.
ZOMBIE_LOST_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION: {FLAVOR}Armed with his sturdy kettle and even sturdier moustache, Kettlehead Adventurer is ready to ruin your day and possibly make a stew.
ZOMBIE_LOST_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: His kettle-bucket gives him great resistance to damage.
ZOMBIE_LOST_BUGZOMBIE_DESCRIPTION: Bug Zombie and Bug make a great team, partly because Bug gives Bug Zombie great mobility, but mostly because they share an intense disinterest in horses.
ZOMBIE_LOST_BUGZOMBIE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Bug carries zombie in over ground defenses and lifts him over barriers.
ZOMBIE_LOST_DESCRIPTION: {FLAVOR}Adventurer Zombie was certain he was the first to rediscover the Lost City. He was less certain after he ran into another 50 Adventurer Zombies at the gift shop.
ZOMBIE_LOST_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}throws Lost City Imp when damaged

{FLAVOR}Porter Gargantuar actually provided the bulk of the funding for the expedition. And most of the bulk all around, come to think of it.
ZOMBIE_LOST_IMP_DESCRIPTION: {FLAVOR}Nepotism got Lost City Imp where he is. He’s Bug Zombie’s second cousin thrice removed, but he parlayed that connection into a sweet gig getting carried around in a little box.
ZOMBIE_LOST_IMP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Gets tossed past most defenses, then explores on foot.
ZOMBIE_LOST_JANE_DESCRIPTION: Parasol Zombie desperately wants to get to the opera before the curtain rises. She’s not going to make it, though, because it’s thousands of miles away on another continent.
ZOMBIE_LOST_JANE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Parasol provides protection from lobbed projectiles.
ZOMBIE_LUNAR_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}370 (cone) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}50% resistant to fire damage

{FLAVOR}Lunar Conehead has prepared himself for this year's celebration. That preparing mostly having to do with making sure that his cone was indeed, placed on top of his head. He forgot last year, and his new year's resolution last year was to not repeat that same mistake again.
ZOMBIE_LUNAR_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: His golden cone provides twice amount of protection compared to a normal Lunar zombie.
ZOMBIE_LUNAR_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1100 (bucket) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}50% resistant to fire damage

{FLAVOR}Stuck being in charge with firework duty again this year, he came up with a brilliant idea to cover his ears up by wearing a bell on top of his head to muffle the noise of firecrackers he has to put up with. Unfortunately, the imps he worked with got one over him and just pounded the bell on his head, releasing a ringing noise right into his eardrums. For next year, he's decided to just settle with earmuffs.
ZOMBIE_LUNAR_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: His bucket, or in this case a giant bell fitted onto his head, provides great resistance from damage.
ZOMBIE_LUNAR_BANDIT_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}760
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}50% resistant to fire damage
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}swings past defenses randomly in the 4th, 5th or 6th column then heads the opposite way

{FLAVOR}Lunar Bandit Zombie isn't any better than his brother Lunar Raider Zombie. He brought a sack full of money when he was told to bring an empty sack. At least he didn't forget to bring his mask unlike SOME imbecile. However, he remembered he left the TV on before leaving the house so he needs to go and deal with more important business.
ZOMBIE_LUNAR_BANDIT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Swings in past defenses and regrets his choices.
ZOMBIE_LUNAR_CAMEL_ALMANAC_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}250 (lion dancer sign) + 170
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.12
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}50% resistant to fire damage
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}arrives in a group of three zombies or more

{FLAVOR}Last year's performance led to these zombies ditching the huge lion suit in favor of plates with symbols of a dragon on top of them. It might be heavier, but it's definitely less scratchy and stuffy than the suit.
ZOMBIE_LUNAR_CAMEL_ALMANAC_DESCRIPTION_H: Arrives in step with other Lunar Camel Zombies.
ZOMBIE_LUNAR_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}50% resistant to fire damage

{FLAVOR}The rise of the new moon is upon us, which means it's that time of the year again. He was ready to lose himself to all the frivolities that come with the new year celebrations, so you could imagine his frustration when he had to go to work and fight plants on new years. But he supposed he couldn't get away with sick leave 3 years in a row. Dr. Zomboss will catch on eventually.
ZOMBIE_LUNAR_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Regular red and gold donning zombie.
ZOMBIE_LUNAR_FLAG_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}50% resistant to fire damage

{FLAVOR}The celebrations can't happen without the flag, and someone had to step up and take that job. It's not the most exciting job in the world, holding a flag, but it pays surprisingly well.
ZOMBIE_LUNAR_FLAG_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Marks the arrival of a huge moonlit "wave" of zombies.
ZOMBIE_LUNAR_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}3600
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.24
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}50% resistant to fire damage
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}crushes plants with a giant stick of bamboo
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}throws Wooly Imp when damaged

{FLAVOR}This Gargantuar's outfit has been a matter of study for Gargologists all around the globe. Fascinating trinkets of Chinese culture are all over. For example: the symbol on his basket means fortune. In the context of Lunar New Year, putting this symbol upside down like on this specimen conveys that the zombies' hope fortune pours down on them. So essentially, it means to hope for good fortune, in other words, brains. For more fun Gargantuar clothes trivia visit your local Gargologist, symptoms may vary.
ZOMBIE_LUNAR_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION_HEAD: A not-so-intimidating giant when dressed up like this.
ZOMBIE_LUNAR_IMP_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.22
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}50% resistant to fire damage

{FLAVOR}Being the founder, organizer, Chief Executive Officer, inventor, manager, and Chief Justice of the Lunar New Year event, it was his job to ensure the zombies dressed up for the correct animal this year. Clearly he did not do his job well, but this was a deliberate mistake on his part. He wears this outfit everyday and never parts from it. If you are reading this on the year of the sheep, then this imp can be considered the best Lunar organizer to exist.
ZOMBIE_LUNAR_IMP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Is thrown onto the lawn past your defenses with a soft impact, then shuffles ahead.
ZOMBIE_LUNAR_MONEYTREE_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}700
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}50% resistant to fire damage
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}drops three yuanbaos in a 3x3 pattern, yuanbaos are indestructible but go away after ten seconds
{KEYWORD}Weakness: {STAT}wall and ground plants stop yuanbaos from rising
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}bashes plants with a yuanbao instead of eating

{FLAVOR}Moneytree Zombie has a particular bone to pick with the saying "Money doesn't just grow on trees." If his years of enlightenment from spiritual retreats, as well as his booming wood processing factory could say anything on the matter, it would be the fact that Money does in fact, grow from trees. The lack of foresight that the people of olden days have displayed regarding the benefits of potential business opportunities created from lumber has always been discrediting for him.
ZOMBIE_LUNAR_MONEYTREE_DESCRIPTION_HEADE: Moneytree Zombies occasionally drop three yuanbaos around them. The yuanbaos can crush plants and block projectiles.
ZOMBIE_LUNAR_NEWSPAPER_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}800 (newspaper) + 460
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.22 (normal), 0.88 (when angry)
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}50% resistant to fire damage
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}deals 2 times the normal damage normally, 8 times the normal damage when angry

{FLAVOR}With a new year, come new crossword pages. He is still trying to solve last year's page.
ZOMBIE_LUNAR_NEWSPAPER_DESCRIPTION_HEADE: Newspaper protects celebratory zombie, who is then enraged when it is destroyed.
ZOMBIE_LUNAR_RELICHUNTER_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}760
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.155
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}50% resistant to fire damage
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}swings past defenses randomly in the 4th, 5th or 6th column

{FLAVOR}Lunar Raider Zombie hit all the marks on what he was supposed to do, except for the part where he was supposed to wear a mask to cover his face, which he didn't bring. He has a valid excuse though because he left it at the dry cleaners. Don't ask what he's trying to get off his mask.
ZOMBIE_LUNAR_RELICHUNTER_DESCRIPTION_HEA: Swings in past defenses, ready to be a sneaky thief.
ZOMBIE_LUNAR_SUPERFANIMP_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}270
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.22
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}50% resistant to fire damage
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}explodes and deals 300 damage to a random plant in the 1st, 2nd or 3rd column

{FLAVOR}The new year can mean only one thing for a kid like him, and that's how much money he's gonna get from all those red envelopes the grown-ups are handing out every year.
ZOMBIE_LUNAR_SUPERFANIMP_DESCRIPTION_HEA: An all-too-enthusiastic imp with way too much excitement for the celebrations.
ZOMBIE_MASHUP_ARCADE_ALMANAC_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}3000 + 5000 (ultra arcade machine)
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}throws energy drinks to attack plants
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}summons an Ultra Arcade Machine
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}pushes Ultra Arcade Machine on defeat
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}80% resistant to fire damage

{FLAVOR}Dr. Zomboss came from a proud lineage of evildoers, and one would've never thought that the powerful and striking Dr. Zomboss was related to a dinky, good-for-nothing moocher of a nephew, as he would describe it. But as begrudgingly reminded by his nag of an aunt and mother, family comes first.
Pushes out an arcade cabinet that spits out hyper-realistic video game zombies.
ZOMBIE_MECH_CONE_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}2500
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.16

{FLAVOR}Zombie engineers considered the orange cone the height of zombie protective technology. It wasn't until they perfected the design for the Robo-Cone that someone remembered the bucket.
ZOMBIE_MECH_CONE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: The armor-plated cone offers phenomenal protection for its pilot.
ZOMBIE_MINIBOSS_IMPFINITY_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}2000
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.2
{KEYWORD}Seasonal Spirit: {STAT}immune to most status effects
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}deals 2 times the normal damage
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}immune to fire damage

{FLAVOR}He was the patient zero for Dr. Zomboss' slightly more powerful boost formula. He had no say in this however, as Dr. Zomboss had given it to him with the guise of it actually being cough syrup.
ZOMBIE_MINIBOSS_IMPFINITY_DESCRIPTION_HE: Creates multiple clones of himself upon taking some hits, then heroically strides forward.
ZOMBIE_MODERN_ALLSTAR_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1100
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.16 (normal), 0.5 (tackling)
{KEYWORD}Weakness: {STAT}Magnet-shroom can pull off his head

{FLAVOR}All-Star Zombie is a third-round draft pick and shows a lot of promise, but come on, his salary demands are beyond ridiculous. Ten million brains per year? For FIFTY YEARS?
ZOMBIE_MODERN_ALLSTAR_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: A heavy-duty zombie who charges your defensive line.
ZOMBIE_MODERN_BALLOON_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}650 (balloon) + 250
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.4

{FLAVOR}Balloon Zombie has no idea where the balloon came from, but he's going with it and he's open to seeing where it takes him.
ZOMBIE_MODERN_BALLOON_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Balloon carries zombies over barriers and ground defenses.
ZOMBIE_MODERN_BERSERKER_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1400
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.1 (normal), 2.0 (tackling)
{KEYWORD}Weakness: {STAT}Magnet-shroom can pull off his head

{FLAVOR}Was told to go to the bench area after committing a penalty barreling through a junior league team called the  Suburban Sprouts, he got lost on the way there pretty bad. The silver lining is that he gets to tackle pretty much anyone he wants, anytime. He views the entire rift as his personal sports arena. They call him the Rift Slammer.
ZOMBIE_MODERN_BERSERKER_DESCRIPTION_HEAD: A heavy-duty zombie who charges your defensive line multiple times.
ZOMBIE_MODERN_NEWSPAPER_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}800 (newspaper) + 460
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.22 (normal), 0.88 (when angry)
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}deals 2 times the normal damage normally, 8 times the normal damage when angry

{FLAVOR}You can't really blame him for getting so upset; he was THIS close to finishing the crossword (23 down was "Brains.")
ZOMBIE_MODERN_NEWSPAPER_DESCRIPTION_HEAD: Newspaper protects zombie, who is then enraged when it is destroyed.
ZOMBIE_MODERN_SUPERFANIMP_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}270
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.22
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}explodes and deals 300 damage to a random plant in the 1st, 2nd or 3rd column

{FLAVOR}Super-Fan Imp has season tickets, subscribes to the team newsletter, and is super pumped about exploding on contact with fans of the opposing team.
ZOMBIE_MODERN_SUPERFANIMP_DESCRIPTION_HE: An all-too-enthusiastic imp who explodes with rah-rah-rah fervor.
ZOMBIE_MUMMY_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}370 (cone) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}Conehead Mummy Zombie prefers the circular cone shape over the typical pyramid shape. It's a fashion thing, and Conehead Mummy Zombie always stays ahead of fashion.
ZOMBIE_MUMMY_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: His cobra cone headdress makes him twice as tough as normal mummies.
ZOMBIE_MUMMY_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1100 (bucket) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}Buckethead Mummy Zombie graduated Magna Zom Louder from Zombie Academy where he learned to utilize his diaphragm during groaning lessons.
ZOMBIE_MUMMY_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: His sandy bucket greatly protects him from damage.
ZOMBIE_MUMMY_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}2200 (pyramid) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}Pyramid-Head Zombie isn't aware that his pyramid is pyramid-shaped. He's a little slow in that respect.
ZOMBIE_MUMMY_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: His pyramid-shaped headgear provides triangular noggin protection.
ZOMBIE_MUMMY_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}Is he a mummy? Is he a zombie? It turns out he's a zombie who's rolled himself in toilet paper to protect his fair skin. True fact!
ZOMBIE_MUMMY_FLAG_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}Egyptian Flag Zombie is so far behind he thinks he's in first place. He's clearly living in de-Nile.
ZOMBIE_MUMMY_FLAG_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Marks the arrival of a huge sandy "wave" of zombies.
ZOMBIE_MUMMY_FLAG_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}350
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.4

{FLAVOR}Sometimes, a regular Flag Mummy Zombie simply isn't enough to inspire the desired amount of terror and disgust. In these instances, upgrading to the Egypt Rally Zombie isn't the sensible choice, it's the only choice.
ZOMBIE_MUMMY_FLAG_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION_HE: He celebrates with increased vigor and truculence the arrival of a new wave of bandaged baddies.
ZOMBIE_NEWSPAPER_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1800 (newspaper) + 490
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.22 (normal), 0.88 (when angry)
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}deals 3 times the normal damage normally, 15 times the normal damage when angry

{FLAVOR}Sunday Edition Zombie REALLY loves the comics section, which is why his rage is so all-consuming when it is torn to tatters before he's finished reading it.
ZOMBIE_NEWSPAPER_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION_HEA: The newspaper protects zombie, who becomes enraged when it is destroyed.
ZOMBIE_PELICAN_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}270
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.6
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}floats over low plants

{FLAVOR}The Pelican Zombie upgraded from the Seagull Zombie and has no regrets. No egrets, either. Just a pelican.
ZOMBIE_PELICAN_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Pelican Zombie crosses water without a plank and flies over low plants.
ZOMBIE_PHARAOH_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1200 (sarcophagus) + 290
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185 (when entombed), 0.5 (freed)

{FLAVOR}The second cousin once removed of King Rot, he rose to power with his disappearing sarcophagus act, but met his untimely end in an unfortunate goat accident. His tale is told in great detail on the back of his sarcophagus, which no one will ever see.
ZOMBIE_PHARAOH_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: His sarcophagus greatly protects him but slows down a rather fast zombie.
ZOMBIE_PIANO_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}840
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.12
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}crushes plants with piano
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}causes cowboy zombies to switch lanes

{FLAVOR}Pianist Zombie only knows two songs, and they're both groaners.
ZOMBIE_PIANO_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: His rolling piano crushes plants while his music causes dancing zombies to switch lanes.
ZOMBIE_PIRATE_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}370 (cone) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}Conehead Pirate is a simple zombie. When asked what his favorite dish is, he'd think for a moment, straighten his ascot, and say, "Rrurrarrbrains." Perhaps he could borrow a cup, neighbor?
ZOMBIE_PIRATE_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: His Jolly Roger cone makes him twice as tough as normal pirates.
ZOMBIE_PIRATE_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1100 (bucket) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}Buckethead Pirate Zombie is looking for his bucket. Have you seen it? It's where? Up where? Speak up, he can't hear you.
ZOMBIE_PIRATE_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: His sturdy wooden bucket provides excellent protection from damage.
ZOMBIE_PIRATE_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}2200 (barrel) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}Dredged from the deepest of seas, Barrelhead Zombie's barrel is a high-quality cask that fits just a bit too snugly.
ZOMBIE_PIRATE_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Barrelhead Zombie's keg-like hat provides augmented protection.
ZOMBIE_PIRATE_BARREL_DESCRIPTION: {FLAVOR}What could it be? Could it be gold? Or some sort of other kind of treasure?  Who knows!
ZOMBIE_PIRATE_BARREL_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Contains Imp Zombies that launch out when destroyed.
ZOMBIE_PIRATE_CAPTAIN_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}420
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.15
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}parrot pet steals plants

{FLAVOR}Pirate Captain Zombie isn't actually a captain.  His dry cleaning got mixed up with someone else's, but he thought he looked cool with an eye patch.  Plus, the parrot already knew his name, so he just went with it.
ZOMBIE_PIRATE_CAPTAIN_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: His parrot can fly away with your plant and then return to him.
ZOMBIE_PIRATE_CAPTAIN_PARROT_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}300
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}1.5
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}can fly to plants in other lanes to carry them away

{FLAVOR}He's a third generation aviation revolutionary. He wants to serve his pirate brethren like his father and his grandmother, Salty Anne, before him.
Quickly flies from the Captain to carry away a plant.
ZOMBIE_PIRATE_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}Keeping up with the latest pirate trends is always tricky, but remember, he was planking before it was cool.
ZOMBIE_PIRATE_FLAG_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Marks the arrival of a huge salty "wave" of zombies.
ZOMBIE_PIRATE_FLAG_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}350
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.4

{FLAVOR}Jolly Roger Zombie and his flag are fused together into a single brain-munching unit. Their teamwork is an inspiration to ghouls everywhere.
ZOMBIE_PIRATE_FLAG_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION_H: Jolly Roger Zombie marks the arrival of lots and lots of zombies.
ZOMBIE_PIRATE_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}3600
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.24
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}crushes plants with shark
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}fires off Pirate Imp when damaged

{FLAVOR}Gargantuar Pirate likes short walks off the plank, moonlit raiding parties, and the smell of cannon fire. A true romantic.
ZOMBIE_PIRATE_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION_HEA: Enormous zombie who redefines the shark attack.
ZOMBIE_PIRATE_IMP_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.22

{FLAVOR}He was a bootblack, with a side trade as a pickpocket on the streets of London, but all he stole were oversized footwear. "Time to steal some booty!" was his catchphrase.
ZOMBIE_PIRATE_IMP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Prefers the compact space of barrels, both cannon and rolling.
ZOMBIE_PLANTAGENET_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}^F17925^Part of the Lunar Rainbow Market collaboration, originating from PvZ 2 SHUTTLE.

{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}370 (cone) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}A royal with a strong sense of fashion and originality. He's enjoyed his affluent unlife believing his cone was the best of them all even across time and after crossing into our world, be the best in the multiverse. This belief was shattered the moment he met the Carnie Coneheads.
ZOMBIE_PLANTAGENET_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_HE: His magnificent cone provides twice as much wealth in sturdiness compared to those impoverished in armor.
ZOMBIE_PLANTAGENET_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}^F17925^Part of the Lunar Rainbow Market collaboration, originating from PvZ 2 SHUTTLE.

{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1100 (bucket) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}Extremely displeased at the fact that he needs to pour 0.03% of his wealth just to forge and wear protective armor into battle. That financial hole will never, ever be patched up.
ZOMBIE_PLANTAGENET_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_HE: His ornate golden bucket provides splendid protection from barbaric attacks.
ZOMBIE_PLANTAGENET_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}^F17925^Part of the Lunar Rainbow Market collaboration, originating from PvZ 2 SHUTTLE.

{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}Determined to keep the influence of his royal house in his homeworld, him and his colleagues happened to stumble upon the Rainbow Market after an unusual turn of events. Luckily for him, he happened to stumble upon Greedy, and shook hands on a deal that would benefit them both. Despite their universal and temporal differences, they both got along quite well, now ready to spread their wealth and influence to our world. The House of Plantagenet shall now live on through universes.
ZOMBIE_PLANTAGENET_FLAG_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}^F17925^Part of the Lunar Rainbow Market collaboration, originating from PvZ 2 SHUTTLE.

{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}Always groaning about how uncivilized it is for him and his fellow nobles are by charging like a mob towards the plants, thinking it's a step back for their royal image as the House of Plantagenet even if they're already dead. Greedy promptly reminded that zombie that he is but a second-rate noble, and that the godfather knows better.
ZOMBIE_PLANTAGENET_FLAG_DESCRIPTION_HEAD: Marks the arrival of a huge luxurious "wave" of zombies.
ZOMBIE_PLANTAGENET_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTIO:
{KEYWORD}^F17925^Part of the Lunar Rainbow Market collaboration, originating from PvZ 2 SHUTTLE.

{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}3600
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.24
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}crushes plants with ladle
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}launches Server Imp when damaged

{FLAVOR}Said to be a master of cuisine back in his home universe. With dishes so good that everyone in the royal house is craving for more, spending much of their money just for a taste. Now that he's here, he's yearning for competition, and he has his sights set on a certain King of the Grill. Will he cook through the competition or get French fried?
Massive zombie that'll make delicious vegan stew out of your plants.
ZOMBIE_PLANTAGENET_IMP_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}^F17925^Part of the Lunar Rainbow Market collaboration, originating from PvZ 2 SHUTTLE.

{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.22

{FLAVOR}At the face of multiple instances of new competition compared to her original dimension, she started to strive to be the best maid. But when your competition is capable of things like sweeping, superb coordination and EVEN flight, not to mention that some of them also serve tea that invigorates zombies more, she's fighting an uphill battle. Now her only real advantage is her strong will to keep up.
ZOMBIE_PLANTAGENET_IMP_DESCRIPTION_HEADE: Is deployed past your defenses, then serves forward.
ZOMBIE_PLANTAGENET_NOBLEWOMAN_DESCRIPTIO:
{KEYWORD}^F17925^Part of the Lunar Rainbow Market collaboration, originating from PvZ 2 SHUTTLE.

{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}700
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.12
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}flings and destroys plants using gusts whipped up by her fan

{FLAVOR}More concerned about the smell of her perfume than anything else. The maids do a good job with her daily get-up. Though she's still blissfully unaware of the fact the maids applied Perfume-shroom scented perfume over her favorite Iris-scented one.
Maiden of magnificence that flings plants away with her state-of-the-art fan.
ZOMBIE_PLANTAGENET_PRINCESS_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}^F17925^Part of the Lunar Rainbow Market collaboration, originating from PvZ 2 SHUTTLE.

{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}2000
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}throws her fans at other zombies after stopping at the eighth column, making them invincible for 10 seconds which also removes most debuffs
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}royal aura prevents plants from being planted directly on her tile
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}immune to freeze, stun and stall effects

{FLAVOR}Still looking for an old shoe she lost when she was younger. Has a nagging feeling she accidentally turned it invisible all those years ago. Kids can be quite clumsy after all, royal or not.
ZOMBIE_PLANTAGENET_PRINCESS_DESCRIPTION_: Maiden of royalty that blesses her fellow zombies with the gift of invincibility.
ZOMBIE_PLANTAGENET_WINE_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}^F17925^Part of the Lunar Rainbow Market collaboration, originating from PvZ 2 SHUTTLE.

{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}470
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.22
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}throws cups of wine that deal 25 damage and stun plants and other obstacles for 5 seconds
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}slaps plants instead of eating

{FLAVOR}An enthusiast in everything wine, he is a connoisseur in the arts of its brewery. Just don't remind him that most of the drinks he loves come from Grapeshots. He's already breaking enough glass cups as-is.
ZOMBIE_PLANTAGENET_WINE_DESCRIPTION_HEAD: Throws cups of wine towards plants that deal damage and stun them.
ZOMBIE_PROSPECTOR_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.16
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}appears on the left side of the lawn after dynamite explodes
{KEYWORD}Weakness: {STAT}cold attacks put out dynamite

{FLAVOR}"There once was a zombie who got old, spending all his days looking for gold.  'Til one day in the rain, he finally ate brains... and, wait, where's his other shoe?"
ZOMBIE_PROSPECTOR_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Launches over your defenses when his fuse burns down.
ZOMBIE_RA_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.2
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}tries to steal sun

{FLAVOR}Ra Zombie isn't actually named after the Sun God Ra, though that's a common mistake. He just likes to say "Ra" a lot.
ZOMBIE_RA_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Tries to steal sun, just for safe keeping.
ZOMBIE_RIFT_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}370 (cone) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}The sign isn't misplaced, his stupidity is enough to be a workplace hazard but not quite to the point where he'd be fired. Luckily for him, you won't find any replacements this far out.
ZOMBIE_RIFT_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: His stand sign headwear provides him with increased protection.
ZOMBIE_RIFT_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1100 (bucket) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}Construction Buckethead is of the opinion that the buckets from way back in 2013 are increasingly blasé to the average zombie looking for protection. It's time for reinvention, something retro but also modern, something that screams venetian red. He'd go on about it, but there's surprisingly low interest on investing in new buckets in the middle of nowhere.
ZOMBIE_RIFT_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: His paint bucket provides great protection from damage.
ZOMBIE_RIFT_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}2200 (hourglass) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}He's got all the time wasted here on his mind.
ZOMBIE_RIFT_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: His time-appropriate headgear provides great protection.
ZOMBIE_RIFT_BARRELROLLER_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1100 (barrel) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.2
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}crushes plants with barrel
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}gremlins thrown from barrel when destroyed

{FLAVOR}He used to plunder the seas, while wearing a mask to cover his facial features. The mysterious aspect of his impromptu fashion style, as well as his successful pillages, earned him quite a name. He even got invited to a photo shoot. There, he took off his mask and... you can guess what happened next. The editor screamed at the photographer to remove that image, but it was too late. Next thing you know, his face is on all the almanacs everywhere.
ZOMBIE_RIFT_BARRELROLLER_DESCRIPTION_HEA: His rolling barrel crushes plants, spawns strange imp creatures and provides excellent protection. His face does not.
ZOMBIE_RIFT_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}Compared to some of the other impish construction zombies you may see working in the Time-Space, Construction Zombies like him dabble in much less worldly work, and more in the lines of road work. It's much more mundane, but at least he's got a way to justify the inflated budgets here.
ZOMBIE_RIFT_EXCAVATOR_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}350
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.3
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}smashes plants with shovel
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}deals 3 times the normal damage to other obstacles
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}blocks lobbed shots, but is vulnerable to incoming projectiles

{FLAVOR}After the failed expedition in Lost City, he had an epiphany. The tried-and-true method of deploying Parasol Zombies to protect zombies like himself was simply inefficient, predictable, easily defeated. And some of those punk plants have built up the immunity to being shoveled, which is INCREDIBLY rude! He came up with the perfect strategy with his Parasol compatriots: what if they switched their roles, tried out something new with their weapons? They pitched the idea to Zomboss on the way back to Modern Day... and were kicked out of his vehicle, left here in this rift. Maybe Zomboss doesn't get it, but they keep trying to show their strategy to anyone who happens to roam by here. Surely, someone, someday, will see their vision.
ZOMBIE_RIFT_EXCAVATOR_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Shovel provides protection from lobbed projectiles, and can also be used to smash plants.
ZOMBIE_RIFT_FLAG_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}He always quarrels with architect zombies who provide the flags for him. When asked why, he said that those "Epic Realm" side projects of theirs keep misplacing the construction budget from more important sites.
ZOMBIE_RIFT_FLAG_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: His flag marks the arrival of a huge work-in-progress "wave" of zombies.
ZOMBIE_RIFT_FLAG_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}350
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.4

{FLAVOR}He's the lead of the demolition team. If you read his resume submitted to the Braindella company, you might discover why nobody except you remembers Gentleman Zombie wearing a different hat, Explorer Zombie fully engulfed in flames and OSHA certified Toy Car Imps.
ZOMBIE_RIFT_FLAG_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION_HEA: Construction Rally Zombie marks the arrival of an eyesore of zombies.
ZOMBIE_RIFT_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}4200
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.12 (normal), 0.4 (enraged)
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}crushes plants with tuna
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}becomes enraged when damaged, increasing his speed
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}highly resistant to movement impairing effects

{FLAVOR}It runs in the family. You think he got it bad? Wait until you meet Kindergartenerface Gargantuar and Teenagerface Gargantuar.
ZOMBIE_RIFT_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION_HEADE: Babyface Gargantuar is seventy-five percent of a big deal.
ZOMBIE_RIFT_GARGIMP_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1100
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.22
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}crushes plants with a 2x4, dealing 7.5 times the normal damage

{FLAVOR}He was a prime candidate for some shrink ray experiment called Operation D-S Zombies (short for Dinky-Sized), the end goal was to create a group of portable zombies that would've easily fit into anyone's pockets. Unfortunately, the shrink ray was rife with too many side effects to justify the cost, causing the project's cessation. Gargimp lost his imp along the way and wasn't paid with the gumdrop he was promised. Now he roams the Time-Space smashing things just to pass time. He would've written an autobiography about the whole experience if pens weren't so fun to smash things with.
ZOMBIE_RIFT_GARGIMP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Gargimp is a bit of a small problem.
ZOMBIE_RIFT_IMP_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.22

{FLAVOR}These guys are Zomboss's right-hand crew, always around to build the paths in every era. They've been off-duty for a very long time, and only recently got back to work when Zomboss decided to visit Steam Ages. But, now? They're taking a break. The other guys have been hard at work on those Epic Realm projects. They've got some time until Zomboss gets impatient with finishing the rest of their map building. Give 'em a couple more months. You'll be amazed what they can do in such a short time.
ZOMBIE_RIFT_IMP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Is NOT tossed into your defenses, but will still construct a path forward regardless.
ZOMBIE_RIFT_JANE_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}350
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.25
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}uses parasol to push plants
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}deals 3 times the normal damage to other obstacles

{FLAVOR}Being left behind in this rift isn't so bad. Sure, she got an awful berating from Zomboss for going along with "such a stupid, idiotic, quite frankly moronic idea," but she's seen lots of exciting stuff! Witnessing the daily work commutes by ZCorp employees, the construction crews build access roads to new time periods, the daily commute of zombies to Piñata Parties, the beautiful traffic jams of Tumble-Weasels every other Tuesday. But she's also seen a lot of weird stuff. She's pretty sure she saw an entire time period change overnight, into some weird futuristic ship in the sky, specifically after some old guy traveling in a massive robot bird took that exit. The others insist it was always like that, but she's convinced she knows what she saw. Maybe the isolation from zociety is getting to her at this point.
ZOMBIE_RIFT_JANE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Parasol provides protection from incoming projectiles, and can be used to push plants.
ZOMBIE_RIFT_SNIFFER_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1000
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.25
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}sniffing does no damage, but helps it block shots for other zombies

{FLAVOR}The Sniffer is a fabled being among zombiekind, originating from ancient Atlantian mythology. Some say that the being is simply a project Dr. Zomboss abandoned to create a zombie of great nose, for whatever purpose that would serve. Others, however, insist that The Sniffer originates from an alternate reality, one where the laws and decorum of polite zociety are left behind in favor of lawlessness, absurdity, and utter nautical nonsense. The Sniffer, however, insists that these factions should not engage in war over its origin, for war does not determine who is right, only who is left.
ZOMBIE_RIFT_WEASEL_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1100
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.2
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}crushes plants, dealing 10 times the normal damage

{FLAVOR}These Tumble-Weasels are abnormalities in the weasel process. Dr. Zomboss mandates that these must be dumped into the rift, as they are simply too rotund for his liking. Despite being rare, because so many are dropped off here in the rift, they are a nuisance to travelers, often causing traffic jams and accidents as they roll across the highway. It's really bad during holidays.
ZOMBIE_RIFT_WEASEL_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Soft, rotund specimen that crushes plants as it rolls down the lane.
ZOMBIE_ROMAN_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION: Was there enough traffic in Ancient Rome to justify cones? Historians differ. It's a real debate.
ZOMBIE_ROMAN_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: A traffic cone made of marble provides some protection.
ZOMBIE_ROMAN_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION: They had buckets just like this back in Ancient Rome. Believe it.
ZOMBIE_ROMAN_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: A fancy bucket with a bit of flair distinguishes this zombie.
ZOMBIE_ROMAN_ARMOR3_DESCRIPTION: Did you know that in Ancient Rome, a centurion commanded a century? Isn't that wild?
ZOMBIE_ROMAN_ARMOR3_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: A higher grade of Roman Zombie.
ZOMBIE_ROMAN_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTION: Bust Head Zombie belongs in museum with a big sign that says something like, "WARNING: THIS IS A ZOMBIE!"
ZOMBIE_ROMAN_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: A bust head means this Roman zombie can take a serious beating.
ZOMBIE_ROMAN_BALLISTA_DESCRIPTION: Surprise! That exploding vase has a zombie in it! Isn’t that surprising?
ZOMBIE_ROMAN_BALLISTA_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: A ballista from Ancient Rome, the Zcorpion Zombie launches an exploding vase at the nearest plant in its lane.
ZOMBIE_ROMAN_FLAG_DESCRIPTION: In Ancient Rome, flags were often used on the battlefield to direct troop movements. Though come on: how much direction do you really need to shuffle leftward?
ZOMBIE_ROMAN_FLAG_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: The flag indicates more zombies are on their way!
ZOMBIE_ROMAN_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION: He's got a column and he's not afraid to use it.
ZOMBIE_ROMAN_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION_HEAD: Wears a helmet. Throws an imp AND a net. Just a real piece of work.
ZOMBIE_ROMAN_HEALER_DESCRIPTION: Hot tip: take this one out as fast as you can if you don't want your life turned into a pit of abject misery and despair.
ZOMBIE_ROMAN_HEALER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Uses weird Roman magic to heal zombies.
ZOMBIE_ROMAN_IMP_DESCRIPTION: Like all Zombie Imps, Roman Imp keeps turning up where you least want him.
ZOMBIE_ROMAN_IMP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Small. Impy. Wears a former lion.
ZOMBIE_ROMAN_MEDUSA_DESCRIPTION: Hailing originally from Greece but thriving in Rome, Zombie Medusa takes advice from her snakes based on their charisma and shared personal hisssstory.
ZOMBIE_ROMAN_MEDUSA_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Zombie Medusa pushes petrified zombies in stone blocks as well as stoneifying zombies and zomboids that face her.
ZOMBIE_ROMAN_SHIELD_ALMANAC_DESCRIPTION: The shield protects him from bad reviews and hurtful remarks.
ZOMBIE_ROMAN_SHIELD_ALMANAC_DESCRIPTION_: A dull-witted, unusually shy Roman zombie who's also carrying a shield.
ZOMBIE_ROMAN_SHIELD_PAIR_DESCRIPTION: When three Roman shield zombies are too many, how about two? Two's a good number, right? It's even, it's prime... it's got everything!
ZOMBIE_ROMAN_SHIELD_PAIR_DESCRIPTION_HEA: A pair of Roman shield zombies.
ZOMBIE_ROMAN_SHIELD_TRIAD_DESCRIPTION: This number of shield zombies is three higher than zombies can count.
ZOMBIE_ROMAN_SHIELD_TRIAD_DESCRIPTION_HE: Three Roman shield zombies in a row.
ZOMBIE_SEAGULL_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}270
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.355
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}floats over low plants

{FLAVOR}Seagull Zombie has racked up the frequent flier miles and dreams of going to the top colleges in the world on a cerebral gastronomy vacation.
ZOMBIE_SEAGULL_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Crosses watery gaps without a plank and flies over low plants.
ZOMBIE_SERVANT_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}^808080^Part of the Lunar Rainbow Market collaboration, originating from PvZ 2 Edgest.

{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}370 (cone) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}immune to poison effects

{FLAVOR}Everyone thinks the clock is an attempt at gaining time manipulation, but she's actually just really tardy.
ZOMBIE_SERVANT_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Her time keeping cone keeps her well protected, and on time.
ZOMBIE_SERVANT_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}^808080^Part of the Lunar Rainbow Market collaboration, originating from PvZ 2 Edgest.

{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1100 (bucket) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}immune to poison effects

{FLAVOR}She has heard that the one painted on her bucket can manipulate fate and destiny. Not wanting to keep her own future merely in the hands of whatever zombie is in power, she hopes this tribute will allow her to control her own fate.
ZOMBIE_SERVANT_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Her bucket keeps her well-being and fate well protected.
ZOMBIE_SERVANT_BELL_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}^808080^Part of the Lunar Rainbow Market collaboration, originating from PvZ 2 Edgest.

{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}480
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.19
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}summons imp maids around her every once in a while
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}immune to butter and poison effects

{FLAVOR}That dreaded ringing. The scourge of maidens and nannies alike.
ZOMBIE_SERVANT_BELL_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Rings her bell, summoning imp maids around her.
ZOMBIE_SERVANT_BESOM_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}^808080^Part of the Lunar Rainbow Market collaboration, originating from PvZ 2 Edgest.

{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}480
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.22
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}pushes plants to the left instead of eating
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}deals 3 times the normal damage to other obstacles
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}immune to butter and poison effects

{FLAVOR}Keeping the possessions of Greedy tidy ain't easy. She fears the day his collection gets into theoretical numbers.
ZOMBIE_SERVANT_BESOM_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Keeps your lawn tidy by pushing plants with her besom.
ZOMBIE_SERVANT_BLACK_IMP_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}^808080^Part of the Lunar Rainbow Market collaboration, originating from PvZ 2 Edgest.

{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.22
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}immune to butter and poison effects

{FLAVOR}Many of her kind were lost trying to dig out Greedy's loose change from between the couch cushions.
ZOMBIE_SERVANT_BLACK_IMP_DESCRIPTION_HEA: The smallest cleaning service you could ever call on.
ZOMBIE_SERVANT_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}^808080^Part of the Lunar Rainbow Market collaboration, originating from PvZ 2 Edgest.

{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}immune to poison effects

{FLAVOR}She is trying to replicate the knife tricks that the perfect maid is known to do, but she keeps getting herself cut.
ZOMBIE_SERVANT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Regular maid serving a higher power.
ZOMBIE_SERVANT_FLAG_BUFF_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}^808080^Part of the Lunar Rainbow Market collaboration, originating from PvZ 2 Edgest.

{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}500
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.25
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}immune to most positive and negative effects
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}buffs zombies' speed in a 3x3 radius by 75%

{FLAVOR}Outside of battle, you can often see these zombies in groups of four. They are pretty tightly-knit, doing almost everything together in perfect unison. It's kind of freaky.
ZOMBIE_SERVANT_FLAG_BUFF_DESCRIPTION_HEA: Marks the arrival of a huge serving "wave" of zombies, while also buffing those around her.
ZOMBIE_SERVANT_FLAG_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}^808080^Part of the Lunar Rainbow Market collaboration, originating from PvZ 2 Edgest.

{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}320
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.25
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}immune to poison effects

{FLAVOR}She is under the belief her flag is able to destroy anything. This gives her the impression that she may be able to simply destroy an entire lawn on her own, or simply blow up the horde behind her. Regardless of if this is true, she isn't going out alone just to find out.
ZOMBIE_SERVANT_FLAG_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Marks the arrival of a huge serving "wave" of zombies.
ZOMBIE_SERVANT_FLAG_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}^808080^Part of the Lunar Rainbow Market collaboration, originating from PvZ 2 Edgest.

{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}650
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.5
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}immune to poison effects

{FLAVOR}She is rumored to be a legendary figure, someone who saved the world from a meteorite. They don't know she just caught a small rock that she kept as a pet.
ZOMBIE_SERVANT_FLAG_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION_: Marks the arrival of a massive serving of zombies.
ZOMBIE_SERVANT_FLY_BLACK_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}^808080^Part of the Lunar Rainbow Market collaboration, originating from PvZ 2 Edgest.

{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}310 + 170 (after landing)
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.3 (normal flight), 1.0 (while flying over plants), 0.185 (after landing)
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}flies over plants extremely fast
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}immune to butter and poison effects

{FLAVOR}She enjoys silence, coffee and a good book.
ZOMBIE_SERVANT_FLY_BLACK_DESCRIPTION_HEA: Flies over most plants, landing when taking too much damage. Now adorning black attire.
ZOMBIE_SERVANT_FLY_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}^808080^Part of the Lunar Rainbow Market collaboration, originating from PvZ 2 Edgest.

{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}310 + 170 (after landing)
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.3 (normal flight), 1.0 (while flying over plants), 0.185 (after landing)
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}flies over plants extremely fast
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}immune to butter and poison effects

{FLAVOR}Zombies can already be rather unintelligent, but these zombies take a step above most. You may wonder then, why would anyone hire these zombies? Well mysteriously, when one of these zombies perishes, another will replace them in a day. Many speculate why this happens, but the most common answer is they either come back, or there are so many that they are easily replaceable.
ZOMBIE_SERVANT_FLY_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Flies over most plants, landing when taking too much damage.
ZOMBIE_SERVANT_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}^808080^Part of the Lunar Rainbow Market collaboration, originating from PvZ 2 Edgest.

{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}3600
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.24
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}crushes plants with besom
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}launches Red Imp Maid when damaged
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}immune to butter and poison effects

{FLAVOR}Maid Gargantuar is a total cuddlebug when it comes to imps, she just can't help but squeeze their adorable little cheeks. Unfortunately for her, imps don't reciprocate that sort of love and would like anything but being caught between her hands.
ZOMBIE_SERVANT_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION_HE: The biggest cleaning service you could ever call on.
ZOMBIE_SERVANT_IMP_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}^808080^Part of the Lunar Rainbow Market collaboration, originating from PvZ 2 Edgest.

{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.22
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}immune to butter and poison effects

{FLAVOR}A lot of people have mistaken her for a fairy from a heart-shaped planet. She will continue to deny it, despite being an avid collector of crystals.
ZOMBIE_SERVANT_IMP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: The smallest cleaning service you could ever call on. Now adorning red attire and a new hair dye.
ZOMBIE_SERVANT_RED_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}^808080^Part of the Lunar Rainbow Market collaboration, originating from PvZ 2 Edgest.

{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}370 (cone) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}immune to poison effects

{FLAVOR}No one has the heart to tell her that her clock is broken.
ZOMBIE_SERVANT_RED_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_HE: Her time keeping cone keeps her well protected, and on time. Now adorning red attire.
ZOMBIE_SERVANT_RED_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}^808080^Part of the Lunar Rainbow Market collaboration, originating from PvZ 2 Edgest.

{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1100 (bucket) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}immune to poison effects

{FLAVOR}She owns a prized collection of spears, but she doesn't dare get them dirty on those nasty lawns.
ZOMBIE_SERVANT_RED_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_HE: Her bucket keeps her well-being and fate well protected. Now adorning red attire.
ZOMBIE_SERVANT_RED_BELL_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}^808080^Part of the Lunar Rainbow Market collaboration, originating from PvZ 2 Edgest.

{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}480
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.19
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}summons imp maids around her every once in a while
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}immune to butter and poison effects

{FLAVOR}Much to the misfortune of many, one bell simply wasn't enough.
ZOMBIE_SERVANT_RED_BELL_DESCRIPTION_HEAD: Rings her bell, summoning imp maids around her. Now adorning red attire.
ZOMBIE_SERVANT_RED_BESOM_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}^808080^Part of the Lunar Rainbow Market collaboration, originating from PvZ 2 Edgest.

{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}480
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.22
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}pushes plants to the left instead of eating
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}deals 3 times the normal damage to other obstacles
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}immune to butter and poison effects

{FLAVOR}The reason she wears red is because she's had to clean up some of Greedy's more... personal messes. Hey, he's the boss, so no one really calls him out for being a messy eater with the brain burgers and ketchup.
ZOMBIE_SERVANT_RED_BESOM_DESCRIPTION_HEA: Keeps your lawn tidy by pushing plants with her besom. Now adorning red attire
ZOMBIE_SERVANT_RED_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}^808080^Part of the Lunar Rainbow Market collaboration, originating from PvZ 2 Edgest.

{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}immune to poison effects

{FLAVOR}She wears red because she wants to be just like her hero... the shrine maiden with the red bow, she never could remember her name.
ZOMBIE_SERVANT_RED_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Regular maid serving a higher power, adorning red attire.
ZOMBIE_SERVANT_RED_FLAG_BUFF_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}^808080^Part of the Lunar Rainbow Market collaboration, originating from PvZ 2 Edgest.

{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}500
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.25
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}immune to most positive and negative effects
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}buffs zombies' speed in a 3x3 radius by 75%

{FLAVOR}She is a well known poker player, known for her surprise "Four of a kind" hands.
Marks the arrival of a huge serving "wave" of zombies, while also buffing those around her. Now adorning red attire.

ZOMBIE_SERVANT_RED_FLAG_DESCRIPTION_HEAD: Marks the arrival of a huge serving "wave" of zombies. Now adorning red attire

{FLAVOR}One night, she snuck into a mansion to steal their secret tea recipe. While it's quite good at keeping her team healthy, she is pretty horrified at its contents.
ZOMBIE_SERVANT_TEA_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Drops tea on defeat, which leaves a puddle that buffs zombies that step on it.
ZOMBIE_SKYCITY_ARBITER_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}3000
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.19
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}rams into your home, dealing 1500 damage
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}highly resistant to movement impairing effects

{FLAVOR}The Arbiter-X ponders General Camo's dilemma. What sort of changes would occur if a zombie with the knowledge of the present was sent so far back in time? What sort of leaps and bounds in technology would happen before they were intended to be? The ship's artificial intelligence attempts to discuss this with the zombie driving, but he's too busy making race car sounds.
ZOMBIE_SKYCITY_ARBITER_DESCRIPTION_HEADE: Creates an invisibility field that cloaks zombies behind it.
ZOMBIE_SKYCITY_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}370 (cone) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}Ask him about his favorite joke and he'll repeat the same groaner about air traffic. Members of his platoon have heard that the live zombie missile program is open to new members.
ZOMBIE_SKYCITY_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: His standard issue cone makes him twice as tough as normal pilot zombies.
ZOMBIE_SKYCITY_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1100 (bucket) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}A zombie with big dreams, Buckethead Pilot Zombie once had a dream to one day get an approval to take care of an AH-6 Little Bird when he enlisted. The birder in him was a bit surprised find something that was not little nor a bird, but some giant metal thing. Thankfully, signing up to the Zombie Aerial Combat Unit has provided him with an unexpected benefit: being able to get close and personal with any flock that happens to be passing by, allowing for some lovely photos for his birdwatching book.
ZOMBIE_SKYCITY_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: His propeller bucket provides him with great protection and a backup plan for when he runs out of jetpack fuel.
ZOMBIE_SKYCITY_ARMOR3_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1600 (helmet) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}Contradictory to popular belief, he isn't related to Lost Pilot Zombie. The helmet however is. It's his third cousin twice removed.
ZOMBIE_SKYCITY_ARMOR3_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: His pilot helmet provides amazing protection from damage.
ZOMBIE_SKYCITY_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}2200 (bomb) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}The headwear assigned to these Pilot Zombies were originally designed to explode. That iteration did not last long.
ZOMBIE_SKYCITY_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: His bomb-shaped headwear provides atomic protection from damage.
ZOMBIE_SKYCITY_BATTLEPLANE_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}400 (imp), 750 (plane)
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.4 (normal), 0.6 (losing control)
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}bullets deal 10 damage{KEYWORD}
Special: {STAT}loops around to another lane when he reaches the home ship
{KEYWORD}Weakness: {STAT}catapults can defeat the pilot, but the plane loses control, rams into your home, dealing 400 damage

{FLAVOR}Some zombies don't have grand reasons for doing what they do. Such as this imp, who rams the trigger to watch the mesmerizing lights in front of him unfold.
ZOMBIE_SKYCITY_BATTLEPLANE_DESCRIPTION_H: Uses machine gun to attack plants and the home ship.
ZOMBIE_SKYCITY_CHICKEN_DESCRIPTION_HEADE: A flying chicken invader that flies at full speed to peck at your shield.
ZOMBIE_SKYCITY_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}Initially apprehensive about joining General Camo's militia, he strapped into action after hearing the promise of an airborne zombie utopia after he achieves complete zombie domination. Say what you will, but Pilot Zombie is pretty simple. Give him a city in the sky and he'll serve you for his unlife.
ZOMBIE_SKYCITY_ELECTRIC_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}490
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.16
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}plasma balls deal 20 damage
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}connected plasma balls can chill, paralyze, or slowly destroy plants based on the conduction

{FLAVOR}Scientist Zombie earned high status among General Camo's ranks by working as a double agent, pretending to be a member of Zomboss' forces back in the day. One of his greatest achievements was downing an airship around the Cactus Canyon area by acting as an electrical conductor. He does wish he emptied his pockets before he did it, he burnt up a calling card from one of the Landscapers on board and can't help but feel like he's missed out on a pretty good deal.
ZOMBIE_SKYCITY_ELECTRIC_DESCRIPTION_HEAD: Uses a lightning gun to attack plants with plasma, causing various effects.
ZOMBIE_SKYCITY_ELECTRIC_VETERAN_DESCRIPT:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1000
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.12
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}plasma balls deal 20 damage
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}plasma balls can arc to other lanes and bypass plants

{FLAVOR}Despite watt one might think, he has no patience for puns.
Uses an advanced lightning gun to attack plants with plasma that either stuns or slowly destroys them.
ZOMBIE_SKYCITY_FLAG_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}Flag Pilot Zombie easily achieved his rank by not being afraid of most things. The dark? Cramped spaces? That sounds like home to him. He does have a mighty fear of flags however. Don't tell him.
ZOMBIE_SKYCITY_FLAG_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Marks the arrival of a huge aerial "wave" of zombies.
ZOMBIE_SKYCITY_FLAG_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION_: Rally Pilot Zombie marks the arrival of an alpha strike of zombies.
ZOMBIE_SKYCITY_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}3600
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.24
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}crushes plants with bare hands
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}launches Paratooper Imps when damaged

{FLAVOR}Due to his rather large stature, Colonel Gargantuar is required to pay three times the usual travel fee. Furious, he shouts into the sky, yearning for the carefree life of the imps instead. But... then he looks at his empty wallet, knowing that at least he gets paid for his services, unlike his imp associates, saving his thoughts for another bad day.
ZOMBIE_SKYCITY_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION_HE: Hulking zombie with high command and higher fists.
ZOMBIE_SKYCITY_GAS_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}500
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}damages plants in a 3x3 area
{KEYWORD}Gas Damage: {STAT}100

{FLAVOR}Being a direct evolution to one of General Camo's most notorious strategies, these combat units are equipped with deadly gas dispensers and are not afraid to utilize their full potential. The imp pilots choose to wear a stylish gas mask in honor of the zombie who put them in the position to create havoc. They say it creates a sense of comradery amongst the zombies, but that sense is quickly undermined by all the "passing gas" jokes made by their colleagues.
ZOMBIE_SKYCITY_GAS_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Gas Pod Imps drop in above the skies uninvited and, once ready, periodically unleash deadly doses of gas in an area.
ZOMBIE_SKYCITY_IMP_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.22
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}deals 0.6 times the normal damage

{FLAVOR}"Why not just go inside the house", one of the zombies pondered. "There aren't even any lawnmowers to stop him!" Camo promptly reminded that zombie that he is but a janitor, and that the general knows better.
ZOMBIE_SKYCITY_IMP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Is ejected past your defenses, then tactically retreats backwards.
ZOMBIE_SKYCITY_LAUNCHER_ZOMBIE_DESCRIPTI:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}820
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}missile deals 1600 damage
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}immune to various effects

{FLAVOR}All imp pilots driving these heavy duty weapons share a penchant for senseless destruction, it's practically a requirement. They are also practicing rocket surgeons, an actual requirement needed to operate and operate on these missiles.
If not defeated in time, fires a missile that deals massive damage to the house.
ZOMBIE_SKYCITY_PELICAN_DESCRIPTION: {FLAVOR}The all new Pelican-1 Aircraft was designed to protect all contents within, with an impressive carrying capacity of about 3,000 imps, an ergonomic seat and cup holders, it's no wonder it's currently the bleeding edge when it comes to pelican-based zombie carriers. No matter how much those salty sea dogs try to dispute it, at the very least this behemoth doesn't have to worry about some butter putting a quick stop to its delivery.
ZOMBIE_SKYCITY_PELICAN_DESCRIPTION_HEADE: Flies in to drop off a payload of Paratrooper Imps.
ZOMBIE_SKYCITY_PROTECTOR_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1200 + 500 (force field)
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.16
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}creates a spammable shield to protect from incoming attacks

{FLAVOR}When it comes to using an opponent's technology, General Camo would not consider the prospect at all if it didn't entail being another way to one up that bulb-headed Edgar. The ZACU Protector is an energy field manipulator that is able to outmatch whatever Zomboss thinks he has in the year 2323! All it took is some stolen blueprints and a bounty's worth of depleted uranium-235 as it's fuel source. Just don't ask what the conduit tube attached to the helmet is for when you're going to drive this thing, it's highly confidential and the answer is not pretty.
ZOMBIE_SKYCITY_PROTECTOR_DESCRIPTION_HEA: Creates weaker shields, but regenerates them more often.
ZOMBIE_SKYCITY_ROCKET_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1100
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.175
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}deals 1.5 times the normal damage
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}launches rockets into plants and into the home ship (rockets deal 300 damage)
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}changes trajectory of rockets every shot
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}stops moving foward after reaching the sixth column

{FLAVOR}When it came to creating the ideal super soldier for his Zombie Aerial Combat Unit, General Camo decided on something similar to what he remembers seeing one would be like from his time in the present. His ideal soldier is to be trained in a specialized boot camp, in addition to being provided with several action movie flicks and of course, a rocket launcher for good measure. All bases had to be covered when it comes getting first blood in this battlefield.
ZOMBIE_SKYCITY_ROCKET_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: A zombie with big guns toting a big gun.
ZOMBIE_SKYCITY_TWINSPLANE_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}800 (per cabin)
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.3
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}can only fall after both cabins are destroyed
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}rams into your home, dealing 1000 damage
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}highly resistant to movement impairing effects

{FLAVOR}Double the firepower. Double the airspace superiority. Double the trouble. The only thing they don't like is that they also have to pay double the gasoline cost to get this thing to run. Seriously, they've been waiting on the gasoline price rollback for ages.
ZOMBIE_SKYCITY_TWINSPLANE_DESCRIPTION_HE: Rams into your home, dealing massive damage.
ZOMBIE_SPACE_DANCER_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}280
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185 (normal), 0.28 (jamming)
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}kicks zombies 2 tiles forward when jamming

{FLAVOR}Space Dancer has been credited with assisting in Dr. Zomboss's moon colonization plan a few years back, helping to put the first zombie on the moon. What, you thought they used rockets?
ZOMBIE_SPACE_DANCER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Kicks zombies into orbit with the power of his ZASA internship.
